title: Align Bottom (AlignAndSize)

scenarios.title: Align Bottom applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Align Bottom (BtnAlignBottom) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Align Bottom never moves a shape upwards
scenarios.expected: The bottom edge 330 snaps to 500 of 0/200/500 and never upwards; the slide's bottom edge 540 is the fallback when no guide qualifies; a guide exactly on the edge keeps the shape in place and a repeated alignment moves nothing.

scenarios.title: Align Bottom aligns a real multi-selection to the reference shape bottom edge
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Align Bottom runs its primary multi-select route: three probe shapes created at distinct bottom edges (75/135/195 pt) are selected and aligned, every probe bottom edge equals the reference shape bottom edge afterwards, the feature reports execution, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
